title: Hourly Auto-Dig:Rockefeller Foundation global HQ and COO transition
summary: Dataset-first Rockefeller Foundation pass adds source-bounded global-headquarters semantics at 420 Fifth Avenue and ingests the completed 2026 COO transition, while preserving the existing public-roster recursive target.

sources.title: Ashvin Dayal Named COO of The Rockefeller Foundation

data.research_question: What defensible public global-headquarters geography can be added for The Rockefeller Foundation, and what material current organizational evidence updates its existing public-roster dataset after the HQ slice?
data.method: Refreshed current main, recent successful hourly merges, open PRs/issues, operating documentation, executable v0.9.0 schema, topic manifest, dataset manifests, queued targets, and the global dataset/topic universe through the GitHub connector. Applied a reproducible dataset-first selector independent of row count and hard-excluded the previous three successful hourly datasets. Within the selected Rockefeller Foundation public-roster dataset, resolved the canonical organization target. Reviewed first-party office and contact evidence for HQ semantics, keeping global headquarters distinct from regional headquarters and offices and declining to infer coordinates. Only after the HQ slice was bounded, searched current Foundation news and leadership material and ingested the COO succession as a material roster event.
classification_rules: Dataset-stage sampling is independent of row count.
Previous-three successful hourly datasets are hard exclusions when at least four alternatives exist.
Previous-three dominant geographies are avoided when alternatives exist.
Global headquarters, regional headquarters, office, mailing/contact address, registered office, and other location types remain distinct.
Street address is attached only where first-party address evidence corroborates the organization; no coordinates are created without defensible geocoder or first-party coordinate evidence.
Current news is ingested only when it materially updates an event, claim, relation, location, or organizational state.

findings.selection_algorithm: sort complete dataset/topic pool lexicographically; hard-exclude the previous three successful hourly datasets; sample dataset independently of row count with eligible_pool[seed mod len]; sort the selected dataset's actionable canonical organization target pool and choose target_pool[target_seed mod len]
findings.target_count_note: 37 normalized investigation-target records are present after the prior successful hourly merge; the selected dataset's actionable HQ target pool contains one canonical organization. Repository-wide legacy target rows are more numerous and are filtered by the recursive-target machinery rather than treated as equal dataset-stage tickets.

findings.finding: The Rockefeller Foundation's offices page explicitly identifies New York City as its global headquarters; its current privacy policy gives the Foundation contact address as 420 Fifth Avenue, New York, NY 10018-2702. The packet therefore records a global-headquarters location/relation without coordinates.
A May 14, 2026 Foundation release announced Ashvin Dayal as COO succeeding Natalye Paquin, who would retire August 1; the current leadership page now lists Dayal as COO.
